blurb: Standard single-select dropdown with grouped items and scroll buttons.
description: Radix Select primitive wrapper with support for item groups, labels, separators, and scroll controls on open.
use_when: A native-feeling dropdown select where single choice from many is needed.
avoid_when: Uncontrolled usage without managing form state.
a11y: Full ARIA support via Radix. Keyboard arrow navigation, Enter to select, Escape to close.
